prerequisites: ELEC-A9110 Classical physics/ELEC-A3110 Mechanics and ELEC-A4130 Electricity and magnetism, or corresponding knowledge and skills.
ELEC-C4140 Field theory, ELEC-A7200 Signals and systems, MS-C1420 Fourier analysis, MS-A0502 Probability theory and statistics, or corresponding knowledge and skills.

learning_outcomes.text: The student will understand how the properties of matter can be explained on the basis of quantum mechanics, and how they are applied in modern technology.
S/he will learn, when and how classical mechanical considerations must be modified according to the special theory of relativity.

syllabus_topics: Basic formalism and phenomena of quantum mechanics
